kind: other
depth: deep
reason: deep-count-for-each
-- base/main.tf --
variable "n" {
  type = number
}
resource "aws_sns_topic" "t" {
  count = var.n
  name  = "t"
}
-- base/examples/complete/env.auto.tfvars --
n = 1
-- base/examples/complete/main.tf --
variable "n" {
  type    = number
  default = 1
}
module "m" {
  source = "../../"
  n      = var.n
}
-- head/main.tf --
variable "n" {
  type = number
}
resource "aws_sns_topic" "t" {
  count = var.n
  name  = "t"
}
-- head/examples/complete/env.auto.tfvars --
n = 50
-- head/examples/complete/main.tf --
variable "n" {
  type    = number
  default = 1
}
module "m" {
  source = "../../"
  n      = var.n
}
